s: Lel yom hakkippurim dino keyomo ubo y' seipim: lel yom hakkippurim hare hu keyomo lekol dabar, shekkol debarim haasurim bayyom — asurim ballayla. Vaapillu battosepet shemmosipin mechol al haqqodesh ben millepanayv ben milleacharayv — asurim kol haddebarim haasurim beiqqar hayyom:

Uma hen haddebarim haasurim? Melaka, akila ushetiyya, rechitza vesika, neilat hassandal, tashmish hammitta. Abal en chiyyub karet ella al melaka vaakila ushetiyya, shenneemar "vekol hannepesh asher taaseh kol melaka vehaabadti vego'", veneemar "ki kol hannepesh asher lo teunneh venikreta vego'", usetam innuy hu meniat akila ushetiyya, kemo shenneemar "vayanneka vayyaribeka vayyaakilka vego'", ushetiyya biklal akila. Abal rechitza vesika uneilat hassandal vetashmish hammitta, ap al pi sheggam hem niqraim innuy lipamim kemo shellamedu chakamim mimmidrash happesuqim, mikkol maqom setam innuy lo neemar berob happeamim ella al meniat akila ushetiyya bilbad. Umikkol maqom kevan sheggam hem niqraim innuy lipamim, lepikak gam hem asurim beyom hakkippurim min hattora, shenneemar "shabbat shabbaton", veqibbelu chakamim beperush happasuq shebut mikkol dabar shenniqra innuy lipamim:
Veissur debarim ellu masar hakkatub lachakamim, vehem heqellu bahem kamma qullot kemo shehaya nireh beenehem lehaqel, ukemo sheyyitbaer lepanenu beezrat Hashem:

Melaka ketzad? Kol melaka shechayyabim aleha beshabbat — chayyabim aleha beyom hakkippurim, vekol shebbeshabbat patur abal asur — hu gam ken beyom hakkippurim, ella sheshshabbat zedono seqila veyom hakkippurim zedono karet. Vekol issure hotzaot shabbat nohagin gam ken beyom hakkippurim. Vekol dabar sheasur letaltelo beshabbat — asur letaltelo beyom hakkippurim:

Ella shebbazeh heqellu bo, shehittiru liqanneb yereq, dehaynu lenatteq healim min haqqelachim kede lehashvotam sheyyihyu mukanim lechotkam, veken lehadiach oto sheyyihyeh mukan lebashshelo baereb miyyad, veken liptzoa egozim kede sheyyihyu mukanim laakilat ereb, velo yitztarek litroach bahen baereb. Vekol debarim ellu ap al pi sheasurim beshabbat, shehare hu toreach umekin mishshabbat lechol kevan sheen tzerikim hayyom ad laereb, mikkol maqom beyom hakkippurim hittiru mishshum piqquach nepesh, shello yitztarek litroach bidbarim ellu baereb qodem akilato veyihyeh lo ogmat nepesh beannot napsho baasiyyat debarim ellu keshehu meunneh:

Velo hittiru debarim ellu ella keshechal yom hakkippurim bechol, abal keshechal beshabbat — lo hittiru debarim ellu, gezera shemma yaaseh ken bishar shabbetot hashshana sheyyakin bayyom mah shetztzarik laakilat ereb, shello yabchin shehittiru lo beyom hakkippurim mishshum ogmat nepesh:

Apillu beyom hakkippurim shechal bechol lo hittiru ella min hammincha ulemala, mishshum sheaz en lachosh shemma al yede hitassequto betiqqun hammaakal yishkach shehu yom hakkippurim veyokal mimmennu, kevan shehu achar hammincha shehu qarob leet hetter akila dehaynu tzet hakkokabim vedomeh lo kemi sheyyesh lo pat besallo. Abal qodem hammincha — asur lo lehitasseq betiqqune hammaakal shel ereb, shemma yishkach veyokal mimmennu:

Akshav nahagu kol yisrael leesor qenibat yereq vehaptzaat egozim, vehu haddin shear tiqqune maakalim shel ereb, apillu achar hammincha, lepi shebbedorot acharonim hitchilu leqalqel lemaher velaasot debarim ellu qodem hammincha, lepikak hechemiru alehem veaseru apillu leachar hammincha:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Behitassequt betiqqune hammaakal, abal ligga bookalin — muttar kol hayyom, veeno domeh lechametz sheasur ligga bo bepesach, lepi shebbepesach hu okel shear debarim — chosheshin shemma yishkach issur chametz bepesach veyokal gam et zeh shennogea, kevan shebbeyamim ellu enennu parush umubdal kelal meakila, mah sheen ken beyom hakkippurim shehu parush umubdal meakila legamre — en chosheshin shemma yishkach veyokal, ella im ken hu mitasseq betiqqun hammaakal letaqqeno ulehakshiro laakila, abal bingia bealma — en chosheshin lekak. Ulepikak muttar litten laqqetannim leekol, ap al pi shehaqqetannim yekolim littol beatzman mibbeli sheyyiggeu haggedolim bammaakal. Veim en haqqatan yakol leekol ella im ken yitasseq haggadol betiqqun hammaakal lehakshiro uletaqqeno laakilat haqqatan — muttar lo letaqqeno, kevan shei epshar laqqatan leoklo mibbalade tiqqun zeh:
Venahagu shehattinoqot mesachaqin beegozim al hashshulchan, ayyen siman shl"ch, veen limchot beyadam apillu qodem mincha:
